note: History, not a forecast. High days overlap (a run of highs counts every day), so runs and assets are given beside the days. Companies are today’s (survivors), which flatters what came after their highs; adjusted closes make an all-time high a total-return high. P/E: price ÷ the last four first-filed quarterly diluted EPS (SEC), positive only.
